phase3_findings.description: src/sqllens/agent/tools/run_sql.py lines 73-78: RunSqlTool.execute calls first_sql_keyword / is_read_shaped after the runner already executed the statement; a non-TokenError tokenizer exception lands in the tool's broad except and is reported as 'Error executing query' (success=False, sql_error) although the statement ran. Built-in runners classify first, so only a custom runner that commits before classifying can reach it.

src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py lines 48-49: first_sql_keyword docstring says comments and opening parentheses are skipped 'as that dialect's tokenizer skips them'; the tokenizer only drops comments and the function's own loop skips L_PAREN tokens (line 77).

src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py lines 142-172 (_cte_reference_ids): no test covers a CTE that shares a catalog table's name and reads that table in its own body (e.g. WITH pg_class AS (SELECT * FROM pg_class) SELECT * FROM pg_class on postgres); correctness depends on traverse_scope's cte_sources for a CTE body, AST behavior CLAUDE.md says needs a test.
